title: How to use My Home
summary: Your daily launchpad: what needs attention, today and overdue, at a glance.

blocks.heading: My Home at a glance
paragraphs: My Home is the first screen you see each day. It pulls together what needs your attention — new tasks to triage, what's due today, and anything overdue — so you can start with the smallest next step.
The markings below point out the key areas.

blocks.caption: My Home — the daily overview
blocks.alt: The My Home dashboard with the task summary cards highlighted

paragraphs: Tip: star a task (★) and it appears in your Focus list so it's one click away.
